headline: Korean Film White Blast Tops Local Box Office In Debut Weekend
seoTitle: White Blast Tops South Korean Box Office
metaDescription: The Korean movie White Blast secured the number one spot at the national box office, drawing over 300,000 viewers during its opening weekend.
aiSummaryBullets: The film White Blast reached the number one spot at the domestic box office during its first weekend of release.
Data from the Korean Film Council indicates the movie recorded 310,000 admissions between Friday and Sunday.
The production represents nearly 40 percent of total ticket sales across theaters nationwide since its premiere on November 18.
aiContextParagraph: The black comedy thriller White Blast, which centers on a remote train station, has seen a successful start following its theatrical release on November 18. According to official figures released by the Korean Film Council, the movie attracted 310,000 audience members during its opening weekend from Friday to Sunday. This performance allowed the film to capture 39.6 percent of total ticket sales in South Korea. The film's strong debut performance reflects its status as a notable entry in the local cinema market this week. Industry reporting confirms its position at the top of the box office charts as it continues its domestic run in theaters across the country. The production has drawn consistent attention from moviegoers, marking a significant entry for the black comedy genre in the current seasonal film cycle.
whyItIsViral: The story is currently seeing moderate engagement, having been covered by two independent news outlets.
